name: Matheme — Topology and Harmonics
description: Seven topology mathemes (projective completion, projective line, Riemann sphere, torus-cover-winding, Möbius-Klein, toroidal-poloidal, manifold atlas) and eight harmonics mathemes (whole-tone return, comma, cycle, musical resolution, Metonic, cymatics, perfect six, tetraktys). Source revision dbf3b17; census T25.
